content_strategy: Phoenix core terms remain the gap — 'artificial grass phoenix' (pos 31) and 'artificial turf phoenix' (pos 45) still outside top 30. Build a Phoenix landing page hub (currently /service-areas/arizona/phoenix gets only 2 sessions/week). Mirror the Mesa template that's earning positions 4-15.

Calculator page is the engine — /artificial-turf-calculator/ drove 22 GSC clicks + 48 GA4 sessions this week. Add internal links from every product page (Lush 80, Lucky 77, Lush 70, Lush Primo) to the calculator with anchor text 'estimate your turf cost'.

Pet/dog turf cluster is unranked — 25+ tracked keywords with no top-100 ranking represent clear content gaps. Publish a /pet-turf-phoenix/ pillar page targeting 'artificial turf for dogs phoenix' (currently unranked, high commercial intent).

Provo is the Utah outlier — /service-areas/utah/provo/ pulled 5 GSC clicks and 16 GA4 sessions on 1,748 impressions (CTR 0.29%). Title and meta optimization could 3x clicks. Apply learnings to Saratoga Springs and Salt Lake City pages.

FAQ schema is universal across top pages — comprehensive (Answer/Question/FAQPage on all 5 audited URLs). Next step: add Product schema with aggregateRating to Lucky 77 / Lush 80 / Lush 70 product pages to unlock review snippets in SERPs.
next_steps: Trim home `<title>` from 66 → ≤60 chars (only structural audit finding; affects the highest-impression page at 8,011 weekly impressions).
Provision a dedicated PageSpeed Insights API key (free tier ~25k/day) — 5th consecutive week of 429 quota errors prevents Core Web Vitals tracking entirely.

Backlinks subscription reactivation confirmed (460 links / 164 RD this week vs 416/172 stale). Next week's report will show the first true WoW backlink delta — set a Slack/Notion reminder to inspect for spam patterns since spam score is 21 (up from baseline 0).
